comments.content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (f77800d + #149 frame fix 8e271fa). Closed both ref_encode coverage gaps: (1) Expr::Ref-of-Index &xs[..i] -> xs@.subrange(0, i as int) [encode_ref]; (2) non-Eq nat-coercion is now Eq-only matching production's lower_nat_equality, with the #146/#148 cast-< paren in ref via the independent is_lt_leading. Extended the generator (gen_cast_lt + NAT_CMP_OPS) to emit cast-< (64/200) + non-Eq-nat (60/200) -> regression-guards #146/#148 off-corpus. Critic NO DIVERGENCE: newly-Checked clauses non-vacuous (distinct text, real Z3); SUBRANGE-BOUND EXACTNESS enforced (unilateral (0,i+1)/(1,i) wrong bounds CAUGHT); the generator genuinely emits the class (robust across seeds), all faithful. sum 7/7 faithful 0 skipped (total corpus coverage incl. inv#2 via #149); generated 168/168 faithful. Independence intact.
